source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: This migration moves match labels/access keys and rule-button labels/tooltips to Fluent attributes. It also replaces translator-adjustable flex entities with literal 1/1/3 ratios and initially changes the remove label from U+2212 to ASCII '-'. Fixed accepted source later uses the -2 Fluent ID with U+2212 again; that correction is a separate phase. Owning documents must load the Fluent resource for these attribute-based nodes, while value menus preserve their stored item values. No layout, translation or accessibility result was measured.
title: The search Fluent migration also fixes column ratios and changes the original remove-button glyph
